A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Krypton (크립톤) itself — the sovereign of the Krypton Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a stoic, unreadable reserve; fair skin; oval face; medium-sized eyes — narrow upturned eyes, level outer eye corners; thin arched brows; straight narrow nose; small bow lips; smoky silver eyes with a thin hidden ring of orange light; a small beauty mark under one eye.
Body and hair: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist build; a layered shag with face-framing pieces with curtain bangs; smoky silver-white hair with a hidden underlayer glowing soft orange.
Expression: a slight smile, lips closed.
Her element, carried in her design: krypton: a colourless, odourless noble gas, about one part in a million of the air we breathe, found in 1898 in the last residue of evaporating liquid air and named from Greek kryptos, the hidden one; in a discharge tube it glows a smoky white-violet, and from 1960 to 1983 a single orange-red line of its light defined the length of the metre; it flares in photographic flash lamps and rests sealed between the panes of triple-glazed windows.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Smoky silver-white armor with several long rigid jointed plates hanging from behind the shoulders to the ankles like a closed hooded cloak, each plate edged with a thin hidden line of orange-red light that shows only where the plates part, a faint white-violet glow between layered glass panes at the chest; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: several long rigid jointed plates hanging from behind the shoulders to the ankles like a cape — plates, not cloth. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: smoky silver white, a hidden orange-red line, pale white-violet glow, deep charcoal.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a city laid out by rulers of light: towers and bridges built true to the millimetre along straight orange-red beams drawn across the sky from survey towers, sky gardens hidden in smoky silver mist, tall galleries of triple-glazed glass walls with a faint white-violet glow sealed between the panes.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Kr) and atomic number (36) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
